lang.usage: Choose a language: en or es.
cli.description: Pedacito — local-first AI coding assistant for small and large models.
cli.opt.version: print the installed version and exit

cli.cmd.profiles: list model profiles and their measured scores

gui.mode.task.label: Task/Edit
gui.mode.task.title: Task (ask): single-pass edit — one turn reads and applies your whole prompt
gui.mode.task.hint: Single-pass edit — reads & applies all parts of your prompt together in 1 turn (best for tweaking 1–3 files, HTML/CSS, & bug fixes).
gui.mode.task.ph: e.g. make the sync client retry three times and update its callers…
gui.mode.explain.label: Ask
gui.mode.explain.title: Ask: read-only questions about the code — nothing is written
gui.mode.explain.hint: Ask how the code works. Read-only — nothing is written.

gui.mode.auto.label: Auto
gui.mode.auto.title: Auto: autonomous multi-step loop — PLAN.md checklist, a separate turn + test check per item
gui.mode.auto.hint: Autonomous multi-step loop — splits big goals into a PLAN.md checklist and runs a separate turn + test check per item (best for large multi-file features). Tick “Plan only” in Options to review the plan first.
gui.mode.auto.ph: e.g. add CSV export to the report page, with tests
gui.mode.new.label: New
gui.mode.new.title: New: scaffold a brand-new project in a target directory

gui.mode.how.hint: Ask how to do anything in the CLI or where a setting/feature lives in the GUI. Answers stay out of your coding thread and work even before a model is configured.

settings.pair.title: Dual-GPU / Scout + Architect Pairing
settings.pair.toggle_title: Show or hide the Scout + Architect pairing form
settings.pair.description: The architect is the active planner/editor profile (typically a 24B-35B model on the 24 GB card). The scout is a 4B-9B model on a second GPU/port that answers gather lookup steps, so its reads never evict the architect’s prefix. Saving writes default_profile + scout_profile in one comment-preserving edit and updates the topbar Scout badge.
settings.pair.model_ph: model id on the second server
settings.pair.starter_hint: Starter default: http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or :1235/v1 for a second llama.cpp. The endpoint is never probed here, so an offline second GPU can be configured now.
settings.pair.pick_error: Pick an architect and a scout.

gui.cal.mode_quick_desc: 1 pass per probe (~1–2 min). Measures tool calling, edit format, thinking A/B, specialties, temperature, and speed. Ideal for everyday setup and Strata / local-MoE servers.
gui.cal.mode_full_desc: 3 repeats per probe plus long-context needle and capability checks. More thorough, but slower (can take 5–15+ min on large or tiered MoE models).
